label: If the absence of every contingent concretum is possible but not actual, a being has a power for it
paraphrase: OPEN (P1, Aristotelian grounding of the global possibility; analyst variant, attribution deferred): if some world accessible from w has no contingent concrete being and w itself has one, then some being existing at w has, at w, a power whose exercise would initiate a causal chain issuing in there being no contingent concrete being (PowerFor). An instance of Aristotelian modality (a non-actual possibility is grounded in an actual being's power) for one global proposition only; it is not PGP and does not mention any individual's absence. Pruss's own argument grounds the weaker possibility that every actual contingent is absent (specs/modal-grounding-actual-absence.toml).
